The issuer shows solid capitalization (equity of 36,034M against 86,783M of assets; liabilities/assets about 58%) and substantial retained earnings, which support credit quality. However, liquidity is slightly weak (current ratio 0.94) and earnings are modest relative to the asset base (EBIT 467M on 86,783M of assets), pointing to only mid-range investment-grade strength.

DECISION: BBB
